simple.meaning: עַכְבָּר (ʻakbâr) is a Hebrew object word meaning “a mouse (as nibbling ).” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Leviticus 11:29. The surrounding context includes offering, land, Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to עַכְבָּר (H5909) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.

definitions.full: H5909. akbar עַכְבָּר noun masculine 1Sam 6:4 mouse (Late Hebrew id. ; Aramaic עַכְבְּרָא ; Syriac (in Lexicons) , (PS 22 ); Arabic plural mares murum Frey (Kam), compare also Hom As 338 ; Arabic of jerboa RS K 302 ; see Tristr NHB 122 FFP 10ff. ); — absolute ׳הָע unclean Lev 11:29 (H), Isa 66:17 (compare RS Sem i. 275, 2nd ed. 293 ); plural construct (ה)זָהָב עַכְבְּרֵי 1Sam 6:4 , 11 , 18 ; suffix עַכְבְּרֵיכֶם צַלְמֵי 6:5 .
definitions.rootNote: probably from the same as 5908 in the secondary sense of attacking ;

occurrences.englishText: “ ‘These are they which are unclean to you among the creeping things that creep on the earth: the weasel, the rat, any kind of great lizard,
Then they said, “What should the trespass offering be which we shall return to him?”

Therefore you shall make images of your tumors and images of your mice that mar the land; and you shall give glory to the God of Israel. Perhaps he will release his hand from you, from your gods, and from your land.
They put Yahweh’s ark on the cart, and the box with the golden mice and the images of their tumors.

and the golden mice, according to the number of all the cities of the Philistines belonging to the five lords, both of fortified cities and of country villages, even to the great stone on which they set down Yahweh’s ark. That stone remains to this day in the field of Joshua of Beth Shemesh.

“Those who sanctify themselves and purify themselves to go to the gardens, behind one in the middle, eating pig’s meat, abominable things, and the mouse, they shall come to an end together,” says Yahweh.
